sections.name: architecture
sections.value: DELTA on a live mechanism, not a build. InteractionGate (crates/harnesses/src/interaction.rs) stays the single decision point; PaneObserver stays the cadence feeder; the three consumers (delivery first-attempt, drain retries, pointer worker) stay consumers. Two additions: (1) the gate's verdict gains TIME (idle expiry) and SELF-KNOWLEDGE (echo exemption); (2) a second entry point, permits_injection_fresh, takes one fresh capture at the send boundary instead of trusting the last observer tick. Composer-region parsing becomes a PURE function in pij-harnesses so both the observer and the fresh path share one parser. The TS reference is .pi/extensions/pij/core/daemon/pane-signals.ts with its operator contract at core/daemon/typing-guard-contract.test.ts — port the CONTRACT, not the code. Named non-goal from history: TS's port-level universal weld was emergency-bypassed fleet-wide for over-hold (72b5dd61); idle expiry is the anti-over-hold mitigation and its witness must be seen RED first.

value.decision: Two units, both wave 1, parallel against one frozen seam.
value.rationale: The seam is one pure function signature plus three gate methods — small enough to freeze on day one. u-gate is pure state machine (no I/O, clock injected); u-observer is parsing + wiring. Neither reads the other's unfinished code; the contract test at the seam proves the handshake before composition.

value.name: gate semantics: idle expiry, self-echo exemption, fresh-boundary entry point
value.depends_on: nothing — builds against the frozen seam signature below
value.responsibility: (1) observe_composer stamps a change-time; an unchanged non-blank composer older than the idle window (default 60_000ms, injectable clock + constructor override for tests) no longer vetoes — a parked draft delays, never blocks. (2) record_self_injection(pane, payload): a subsequent composer observation that is pij's own payload (exact whitespace-collapsed match, TS rule) never ACQUIRES a hold; NO echo ever CLEARS an active human hold. (3) permits_injection_fresh(pane, harness): takes one capture via the gate's existing TmuxPort, parses it with the frozen composer_region fn, feeds the observation, then answers. Unknown/unrecognised stays a veto at the tick cadence and DEFERS at the fresh path.
value.interface: FROZEN — pub fn composer_region(harness: &str, capture: &str) -> ComposerRegion; pub enum ComposerRegion { Recognized(String), Unrecognized } (lives in pij-harnesses, u-observer implements, u-gate consumes). Gate additions: pub fn record_self_injection(&self, pane: &str, payload: &str); pub async fn permits_injection_fresh(&self, pane: &str, harness: &str) -> Result<bool>; constructor gains idle window + clock injection without breaking existing new() callers (builder or with_ variants). Existing method names and semantics otherwise unchanged. TmuxPort needs a capture verb at the fresh path — it EXISTS: TmuxPort::capture (crates/tmux/src/lib.rs).
value.test_strategy: Pure unit tests, clock injected, no tmux. RED-FIRST: the parked-draft witness (ac-1111) must FAIL on the pre-fix tree — run it there and paste the red into the receipt. Port the TS contract cases by NAME from typing-guard-contract.test.ts (parked draft ≤60s then sends; typing-through-restart not re-baselined; self-echo never acquires and never destroys; whitespace-insensitive emptiness). Mutation proof: revert idle expiry -> witness fails; loosen echo match to substring -> paste-eaten test fails.
value.note: Do NOT invent a caret/byte-density tracker; tap-active veto stays as-is. Keep it small.

value.name: layout-aware composer recognition + observer wiring
value.depends_on: nothing — implements the frozen composer_region signature
value.paths: a new parsing module in crates/harnesses (e.g. src/composer.rs) + crates/daemon/src/pane_observer.rs + crates/testkit fakes as needed; crates/tmux only if capture needs a flag
value.responsibility: Implement composer_region for the real layouts, ported from the TS parser (.pi/extensions/pij/core/daemon/pane-signals.ts:76-227): OMP box row (╰─ … ─╯), lowest pair of plain ─{8,} rules bracketing a ❯ prompt (excluding box-drawing so markdown tables are not rules), Copilot ❯+footer layout, else Unrecognized. Caret-clip and prompt-strip the payload (normalizeComposerPayload rules). Rewire PaneObserver to classify captures through composer_region and feed the gate: Recognized+blank -> cleared, Recognized+content -> observe_composer, Unrecognized -> record_unknown (veto).
value.interface: Consumes the FROZEN signature above verbatim. PaneObserver public surface unchanged.
value.test_strategy: Fixture captures per layout — take REAL capture-pane text from live panes on this machine (tmux capture-pane -p -t <pane>), not invented renders; label each fixture with the harness + date recorded. TS pane-signals.test.ts region cases (:69-144) name the edge cases to port: copilot footer exclusion, markdown-table-not-a-rule. Unrecognized MUST defer — the discriminator test asserts the veto, not silence.
value.note: If a layout cannot be recorded live (no seat of that harness running), spawn one, record, close it — an invented fixture is the exact green-that-lies shape plan 110 just paid for.

Coders get their own worktrees off s111/anti-step-on; the PM merges, coders never merge. ABSOLUTE PATHS in every packet. Per-worktree CARGO_TARGET_DIR — a shared target has already produced a false red on this fleet. Whoever creates a worktree owns reaping it.

value.composer: PM, on s111/anti-step-on, after both units merge.
value.steps: (1) Wire permits_injection_fresh into the three consumers: delivery first-attempt (crates/daemon/src/delivery/mod.rs:223 region), queued-retry drain, pointer worker (crates/daemon/src/pointer/worker.rs:217). Tick-cadence permits_injection remains for cheap pre-checks; the FRESH verdict is the one that authorises an actual injection. (2) Regression-pin: paneless never gated; existing receipt-honesty decision table green untouched. (3) Daemon config gains interaction_idle_ms (default 60_000) beside pane_observer_interval_ms.
value.integration_proof: Two DeliveryService-level tests: (a) parked draft — non-blank composer, clock advanced past the window, delivery PROCEEDS (ac-1111 end to end); (b) stale-clear/fresh-typing race — observer state says clear, fresh capture says typing, delivery HELD and queued durably (ac-1114). Plus one live smoke on a real pane: type into a composer, pij send at it, watch it queue; clear the composer, watch it land.

value.when: after composition, before the PR into main
value.inputs: req-0004 verbatim + this impl-guide + full branch diff + the TS operator contract (typing-guard-contract.test.ts) as the checklist; priority order: (1) can a parked draft still block forever anywhere; (2) can pij's own echo ever clear a HUMAN hold; (3) is the fresh capture actually at the send boundary or still a cached tick; (4) does Unrecognized defer rather than release; (5) was every witness seen red before its green.
value.model_override: cross-model from the coder's family — coder is gpt-5.6-sol on omp, so the reviewer must NOT be a gpt-5.6 variant; claude or gemini class, chosen from pij models at dispatch time. The reviewer re-derives verdicts by execution, never by reading.

value.text: Over-hold regression (the TS 72b5dd61 emergency): retired by ac-1111 witnessed RED on the pre-fix tree, plus the idle window being config not constant.
Echo certification too loose eats a human's paste of similar text: retired by the exact whitespace-collapsed match rule + the paste test in u-gate.
Invented layout fixtures pass parsing that live captures fail: retired by the recorded-fixture rule in u-observer (record live, label provenance).

Fresh capture races the human's first keystroke (clear at capture, typing at inject): bounded, not eliminated — the window shrinks from observer-interval to capture-to-inject; note it in the findings doc, do not pretend it is zero.
